div.head: V As 1
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe oþres monnes man underfó, ðe he for his yfele him from ðó, ⁊ him getruwian ne mæge his yfeles, gylde hine ðæm þe he ær folgode, ⁊ gesylle þam cynge CXX scll.

Be ðon oþres monnes man underfehþ. And se ðe oþres mannes man underfó, ðe he for his yfle him from dó, ⁊ him gesteoran ne mæge his yfles, gilde hine ðæm ðe he ær folgode, ⁊ gesylle ðæm cyng CXX scill.
Et qui alterius hominem suscipiet, quem pro malefactis suis a se dimittat et castigare non possit, reddat eum domino suo cui prius seruiuit, et regi centum uiginti sol.

[Be ðon (þe) oþres monnes man underfehþ.] ⁊ se ðe oþres monnes man underfó, ðe he for his yfele him from dó, ⁊ him [gesteoran] ne maege his yfeles, gylde hine ðæm þe he ær folgode, ⁊ gesylle þam cynge CXX scll.

(Von dem, der den Untergebenen eines anderen aufnimmt. Ld) Und wer den Untergebenen eines anderen Mannes aufnimmt — den dieser wegen dessen Missethat von sich jagt, indem er ihn von dessen Vergehen nicht zurückhalten kann — entgelte ihn demjenigen, dem derselbe früher untergeben war, und zahle dem König 120 Schill.

(Of him who takes in another's dependant. Ld) And whoever takes in another man's dependant — whom that man drives away on account of his misdeeds, being unable to restrain him from his offences — let him pay for him to the one to whom he was formerly subject, and pay the king 120 shillings.

And he who takes into his service one who has been in the service of another, whom the latter has dismissed because of his evil conduct, and because he has not been able to restrain him from evil doing, shall pay compensation for him, to the man in whose service he has been, and give 120 shillings to the king.

And he who receives the man of another man, whom he dismisses for his wrong-doing, and cannot restrain him from evil-doing, is to pay for him to the man whom he followed before, and give 120 shillings to the king.

div.note: H's ‘getruwian’ should be corrected to ‘gestyran’ from Ld and Quadr. (Liebermann). Liebermann would supply ‘þe’ in Ld's heading from Quadr. Liebermann compares II As 22, 22.1.

note.seg: Dies Kapitel wird benutzt in IV As 4. — Ob die Rubrik schon lq, und dann wahrscheinlich dem Archetyp, gehöre, bleibt fraglich
This chapter is used in IV As 4. — Whether the rubric already belonged to lq, and if so probably to the archetype, remains doubtful

Die Konstruktion ‘jemm. (dt) wehren an (gn.) etwas’ s. Wb: stieran. Nicht etwa ‘ihn [!] reinigen’. — H’s Änderung bed. ‘nicht trauen wegen Missetat’ oder ist Abirrung des Auges zu getruwian 2 Zeilen zuvor

For the construction ‘to restrain someone (dat.) from (gen.) something’ see Wb: stieran. Not, say, ‘to clear him [!]’. — H's alteration means ‘not to trust on account of a misdeed’, or is a slip of the eye to getruwian 2 lines earlier

Nach IV As 4 muss der Mann ins frühere Gefolge (s. d. Gl 8) zurück (wie nach Ine 39), nach II 22, 1 durch Rückgabe seitens des neuen Herrn. Hier aber ist er nicht entlaufen, sondern fortgejagt. Der Entgelt tritt also nicht an Stelle der Person, sondern ist wohl Busse für Bruch des Schutzes (s. d. Gl 4 b. 20 a V), die der frühere zieht (auch nach In Cn II 28), weil Herr beseine Polizei durchkreuzt ward

According to IV As 4 the man must return to his former retinue (see that word in Gl 8) (as under Ine 39), and according to II 22, 1 by being handed back by the new lord. Here, however, he has not run away but has been driven out. The payment therefore does not take the place of the person, but is probably compensation for breach of protection (see that word in Gl 4 b. 20 a V), which the former lord receives (as also under In Cn II 28), because his police authority has been thwarted
= ‘Ungehorsam (s. d. Gl 16)’ II As 22, 1. II Ew 7
= ‘disobedience (see that word in Gl 16)’ II As 22, 1. II Ew 7
Note that this refers to a case different from those of Ine, cap. 39, II Edw. cap. 7, II As. cap. 22 (cf. IV As. cap. 4).
